status: Candidates only, 2026-11-05. Found through the Wikimedia Commons API. None has been viewed, downloaded or copied into the project. Open each file page and confirm what it shows, its date and its licence before use.
rules: Prefer reuse=free. Attribution and share-alike items need the author credited and, for share-alike, the same licence on any adapted image: confirm that suits the project before adapting them.
A Commons public-domain tag can reflect US or uploader status. For twentieth-century Indian photographs, confirm the status in India.
Copy a chosen image into content/media/indian-history/ and record file, source page, author, licence and hash in docs/research/.
Monuments are evidence of the place today. Later paintings and statues are interpretations and must be labelled.
gaps: Not searched, rate limited: Brihadisvara Temple, the 1885 Congress, Tilak.
Nothing usable found: Ashokan edict at Kandahar, Gandhi in South Africa, Tagore in 1919, the 1947 flag and Constituent Assembly.
